item.boundlessrouters.sender_module.desc: Sends items from the buffer to the first inventory in its direction, or to the one it is bound to: any distance, any dimension.
item.boundlessrouters.puller_module.desc: Pulls items into the buffer from the inventory next to it in its direction, or from the one it is bound to, anywhere.
item.boundlessrouters.distributor_module: Sends items from the buffer to many bound inventories: in turn, at random, nearest or farthest first.
item.boundlessrouters.dropper_module.des: Drops items from the buffer into the world in its direction.
item.boundlessrouters.flinger_module.des: Throws items from the buffer as fast and as high as you set it.
item.boundlessrouters.placer_module.desc: Places blocks from the buffer in its direction.
item.boundlessrouters.breaker_module.des: Breaks the block in its direction into the buffer, as a netherite pickaxe would, with silk touch or any fortune you set.
item.boundlessrouters.vacuum_module.desc: Picks dropped items up into the buffer round the router, or round a spot in its direction.
item.boundlessrouters.void_module.desc: Destroys items in the buffer that pass its filter.
item.boundlessrouters.player_module.desc: Moves items between the buffer and its bound player's inventory, armour, offhand or ender chest, wherever they are.
item.boundlessrouters.detector_module.de: Gives out a redstone signal in its direction while the buffer holds what it looks for.
item.boundlessrouters.extruder_module.de: With a redstone signal builds a line of blocks from the buffer in its direction; without one takes it back.
item.boundlessrouters.speed_upgrade.desc: Each takes two ticks off the time between the router's runs, down to every tick.
item.boundlessrouters.stack_upgrade.desc: Each doubles the items a module moves a run, up to a full stack.
item.boundlessrouters.range_upgrade.desc: Each adds four blocks to how far senders look and extruders reach. No limit.
item.boundlessrouters.muffler_upgrade.de: Silences the router: no sounds, no particles.
tooltip.boundlessrouters.router: Plug modules into it to move items about. Keeps its modules when broken.
tooltip.boundlessrouters.bind_hint.place: Sneak + use on an inventory to bind; in the air to unbind
Sneak + use on inventories to add or remove them; in the air to clear
tooltip.boundlessrouters.bind_hint.playe: Sneak + use in the air to bind yourself
tooltip.boundlessrouters.settings_hint: Use: settings. In a router: the gear or a middle click
